prompt: Build a 3-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 3 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.7 * Z0 * Z1 * Z2 (a single three-body interaction term). gamma = 0.6. Any correct implementation is accepted (Z0*Z1*Z2 is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct phase +/-gamma*0.7 depending on the parity of the 3-bit computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition, e.g. a CNOT-ladder-plus-RZ pattern is one valid way but not the only one). No measurement.
